instruction: Using GIMP, add the subtitle 'Hello World' at the bottom center of '/home/user/fullvideo.mp4', timed to display from 1 to 3 seconds.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot add time-synchronized text overlays to videos. While GIMP can add text to static images, it has no video timeline functionality to control when text appears and disappears during video playback.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP is an image editor without video timeline functionality
The evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible()' function which is appropriate for tasks that cannot be completed
Instruction requires time-synchronized text overlays (1-3 seconds) which GIMP cannot provide
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible
